title: UserPreferences
description: Input contract for restaurant recommendation requests (Phase 0). Primary source: basic web UI forms that submit this JSON shape; optional API/CLI may reuse it. Location is required; other fields follow problemstatement.md §2.

location.description: City or region the user wants to dine in (e.g. Delhi, Bangalore). Normalization rules are implementation-defined in later phases.

budget.description: Budget band; must map consistently to dataset cost fields in Phase 1+.

cuisines.description: Preferred cuisine labels. Empty array means no cuisine filter (any).

min_rating.description: Minimum acceptable rating; inclusive lower bound (>=). Use 0 for no minimum if the product allows.

optional_constraints.description: Free-text preferences (e.g. family-friendly). May be soft constraints for the LLM only unless mapped to structured fields later.
